key_insight: A pure LLM can approach top multimodal geometry performance when paired with a diagram-to-symbol parser and a formal symbolic solver.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a more interpretable and potentially lower-cost alternative to end-to-end multimodal geometry systems for theorem-proving-style reasoning.
method: Geometric Vision Parser converts geometric diagrams into symbolic representations.
Symbolic Solver performs formal deductions on the parsed geometry facts.
LLM orchestrates the reasoning pipeline to reduce hallucinations and improve explainability.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluate on a newly curated benchmark of challenging 2025 Chinese Zhongkao plane-geometry problems designed to test novel, deeper deductive reasoning.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate diagram parsing, so errors in symbolic extraction could propagate through the deduction pipeline.
paper_title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
